messages:
incident-bot: PAGER -> P0: Reserved GPU pool 'rsv-prod-3' is saturated. Enterprise tenant PineBank seeing request queue growth and throttling. Autoscaler error: quota_limit_reached. Links: https://dash.internal/metrics/rsv-prod-3 and runbook: https://wiki.internal/runbooks/reserved-pool-saturation :rotating_light:

alice (on-call): ACK. I'm on it. spinning up incident channel. first check: are we seeing noisy-session churn or a true traffic surge?

ben (sre): Metrics show 95% utilization across the pool for 12m, queue length up from 20 -> 800. Autoscaler logs: "failed to provision: Quota exceeded for GPUs in region us-west1". Also seeing repeated scheduling failures and eviction churn. snippet:```ERROR Provisioner: request for 8xA100 failed: QuotaExceeded: 0/64 available```

carmen (eng-runtime): tagging in. Autoscaler reports rate limit when creating instances (cloud API returns 429) followed by quota errors. We have a known fallback path but it didn't trigger because capacity_filter rejected all alternate instance types. Investigating why the fallback policy didn't match.

alice (on-call): Immediate mitigations we can do now: 1) drain best-effort (burst) sessions in this pool, 2) enable temporary fairshare throttling on PineBank to free reserved slots, 3) route non-SLA traffic to hosted API fallback. I'll start eviction and fairshare now.

darren (solutions): I'll message PineBank account contact — Elaine — to notify of degraded behavior and recommended mitigation (graceful retries + rate limit). Elaine, ping when you've got them on the line.

elaine (pm-customer): On it. I'm on a quick call with PineBank infra. They report an internal batch job started at 21:04UTC that's producing many long-running sessions. They'll try to pause. Asking for any immediate config to reduce impact.

ben (sre): Commands I'm running:```# evict best-effort sessions older than 5m
POST /internal/pools/rsv-prod-3/evict
payload: {"policy":"best_effort","age_seconds":300}``` Response: 2400 sessions queued for eviction. Starting throttled evictions to avoid meltdown.

alice (on-call): Also bumping eviction aggressiveness  ->```PUT /internal/pools/rsv-prod-3/config
{"eviction":{"aggressiveness":"high","max_concurrent_evictions":50}}``` Doing this now. Expect reduction in queue in 3-5m.

carmen (eng-runtime): Noted. I'm working the autoscaler fallback rule: the policy that should allow smaller instance types (e.g., 4xA100) is failing because of a label mismatch in the catalog. Quick fix: patch catalog entry to include 'fallback:true' for us-west1. Applying patch and reloading planner.```/svc/catalog/reload --patch '{"instance_types": {"4xA100": {"fallback": true}}}'```

ops-bot: Deployment started: catalog patch roll 5268880123 by carmen (CI job 9821).

ben (sre): Queue dropping from 800 -> 320 after first batch of evictions. Throttling alarm still firing but trending down. CPU on controller jumps briefly during eviction waves. Logs show a few stuck sessions failing to evict due to retry loop; I'm clearing orphaned locks.```/internal/locks/clear --pool rsv-prod-3 --stuck=true```

carmen (eng-runtime): Catalog patch accepted, planner re-evaluating. Autoscaler tries alternate instance types but clouds returns QuotaExceeded for all preferred types. However fallback now allows dynamic rebalancing across regions. Initiating cross-region scale: attempt to allocate in us-central1 as temporary spill.

alice (on-call): Cross-region ramping up - pulling 4 nodes in us-central1 for PineBank reserved mapping. This requires routing change: applying temporary route rule to prefer us-central1 for new reservations for PineBank:```/internal/routing/apply --tenant PineBank --prefer-region us-central1 --duration 60m```

darren (solutions): PineBank confirmed they paused the batch job. Elaine: they expect to resume in ~30min; they'd like to coordinate a backoff policy to avoid repeat. Recommend they add jitter and a concurrency cap.

elaine (pm-customer): PineBank agrees to backoff. They're enabling a 50% concurrency cap and will reschedule non-critical jobs overnight. Appreciate notification.

ben (sre): After cross-region ramp and evictions, pool utilization in rsv-prod-3 dropped to 78% and queue to ~40. Autoscaler shows successful allocations in us-central1. Throttle alarms transitioning to warning.

carmen (eng-runtime): Root cause threads: 1) Cloud quota limit in us-west1 prevented local scale-up, 2) fallback catalog had label mismatch preventing alternate instance selection, 3) tenant burst (batch job) consumed reserved tokens fast. Fixes: catalog label patch (deployed), planner fallback acceptance (in prod), and we'll add proactive quota checks to pre-fail auto-scale requests with clearer error path. I'll open a follow-up ticket for quota preflight.

alice (on-call): Customer impact summary for PineBank: ~12 minutes of elevated latency and 20-40% error-rate window for heavy requests; best-effort workloads experienced evictions. No data loss; requests retried. Action items logged.

ops-bot: Incident timeline recorded: https://incidents.internal/5268880000

darren (solutions): Internal follow-up: schedule a 1hr postmortem w/eng-runtime, autoscaler, and solutions. Need to review quota monitoring and tenant burst protection. I'll set the invite.

elaine (pm-customer): PineBank requests a post-incident note to be CC'd. I'll share their post-incident questions in the follow-up doc.

alice (on-call): Wrapping up active mitigations. Eviction aggressiveness reverting to normal and routing rule set to expire. Final checks show stable queues. I'll keep the channel open for 30m then close if no regression.

ben (sre): +1. I'll follow up on orphaned lock metrics and increase observability around eviction success rates.

carmen (eng-runtime): Creating GH ticket: GH-9843 "Autoscaler fallback failure due to catalog label mismatch" with rollback link and proposed tests.

alice (on-call): Incident status: mitigated -> monitoring. Closing note will be posted to the incident tracker and ops-runbook updated with the extra preflight quota check step. :white_check_mark:
